```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

  dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
output_root <- file.path(report_dir, "outputs")
panel_dir <- file.path(output_root, "seven_donor_manuscript_panels")
table_dir <- file.path(panel_dir, "tables")
qc_plot_dir <- file.path(output_root, "annotation_qc_plots")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(knitr)
})

show_panel <- function(stem) {
  knitr::include_graphics(file.path(panel_dir, paste0(stem, ".png")))
}

strategy_metrics <- read.csv(
  file.path(output_root, "annotation_strategy_comparison_summary.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
strategy_decision <- read.csv(
  file.path(output_root, "annotation_strategy_decision.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
marker_specificity <- read.csv(
  file.path(output_root, "ssc230_annotation_marker_specificity_summary.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
panel_audit <- read.csv(
  file.path(panel_dir, "seven_donor_panel_cell_audit.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
join_audit <- read.csv(
  file.path(output_root, "seven_donor_join_audit.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
fib_cor_stats <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "fibmet_imc_scmetabolism_correlation_stats_seven_donors.csv"
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)
ec_cor_stats <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "endmet_imc_scmetabolism_correlation_stats_seven_donors.csv"
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)
```

# Technical summary

ExcludedValidation was added to the finalized six-donor Xenium SFE after applying its
recorded QC flag, yielding a joined object of **21,271 Xenium cells from seven
donors**. Of the retained ExcludedValidation cells, **594 have validated IMC-Xenium shared
identifiers**; 145 contribute to paired FibMET analyses and 63 contribute to
paired EndMET analyses.

Two annotation strategies were evaluated in parallel. Broad ExcludedValidation population
labels agreed in 90.4% of cells between an all-seven Harmony refit and
independent mapping to the finalized six-donor reference. A Harmony refit was
not stable enough to replace the manually curated fine annotation space:
only 46.7% of the six-donor fibroblast/endothelial subtype labels were retained.
The manuscript-facing panels therefore preserve the finalized six-donor labels
and map ExcludedValidation into that reference; the all-seven Harmony embeddings and
clusters remain available as a sensitivity analysis.

All applicable IMC-only, paired IMC-Xenium, scMetabolism, ECM, Sankey, and
Xenium-only annotation panels were regenerated with all seven donors. Every
panel is exported as PNG, PDF, and SVG using the original manuscript palette,
fixed score ranges, and panel dimensions.

# Seven-donor Xenium annotation {.tabset .tabset-pill}

## Figure S6A: major populations

The all-seven Harmony embedding is displayed using the marker-validated final
labels. This separates the embedding calculation from the annotation decision:
ExcludedValidation participates in the joint geometry, while the labels remain compatible
with the finalized six-donor annotation vocabulary.

```{r xenium_major_umap}
show_panel("xenium_major_umap_seven_donors")
```

## Figure S6B: major markers

Dot size is the percentage of cells expressing each gene and color is the
unscaled mean log-normalized Xenium expression. The lineage-marker diagonal
provides an independent visual check of the final population labels.

```{r xenium_major_dotplot}
show_panel("xenium_major_marker_dotplot_seven_donors")
```

# Fibroblast panels {.tabset .tabset-pill}

## FibMET UMAP

The finalized IMC FibMET embedding now includes all seven matched donors while
retaining the original salmon/cyan phenotype colors and panel ratio.

```{r fibmet_umap}
show_panel("fibmet_umap_seven_donors")
```

## IMC metabolic-score UMAPs

The glycolysis and TCA/OXPHOS protein scores are means of the same prespecified
IMC marker sets used previously. Both panels retain the fixed -1 to 1 color
range so the seven-donor result is visually comparable with the original.

```{r fibmet_score_umaps}
show_panel("fibmet_imc_score_umaps_seven_donors")
```

## Protein expression

Each black point is one donor-level group mean. The displayed paired Wilcoxon
tests therefore use the donor, rather than the cell, as the replicate.

```{r fibmet_protein}
show_panel("fibmet_protein_expression_seven_donors")
```

## IMC metabolic heatmap

Mean IMC marker z scores are shown without reclustering the two FibMET columns.
The color range is fixed to -1 to 0.5, matching the original figure contract.

```{r fibmet_heatmap}
show_panel("fibmet_imc_heatmap_seven_donors")
```

## Donor-level IMC scores

The seven points in each FibMET condition are donor-level means. The paired
test uses donors represented in both conditions.

```{r fibmet_sample_scores}
show_panel("fibmet_sample_scores_seven_donors")
```

## Xenium gene expression

Only fibroblasts with validated paired IMC labels are included. Dot size is
the percentage expressed; color is gene-wise scaled mean expression across
`Other_Fib` and `Met_hi_Fib`, clipped to -1 to 1 to preserve the figure style.

```{r fibmet_gene_dotplot}
show_panel("fibmet_xenium_gene_dotplot_seven_donors")
```

## Xenium-to-IMC Sankey

The widths count paired cells flowing from each final Xenium fibroblast subtype
to its IMC FibMET label. ExcludedValidation contributes through its validated shared cell
identifiers.

```{r fibmet_sankey}
show_panel("fibmet_xenium_to_imc_sankey_seven_donors")
```

## ECM scores

Color and size show the mean core-matrisome AUCell score within each Xenium
fibroblast subtype and paired IMC FibMET state. The score was recomputed from
the joined seven-donor SFE.

```{r fibmet_ecm}
show_panel("fibmet_ecm_dotplot_seven_donors")
```

## scMetabolism

Glycolysis and citrate-cycle AUCell scores were recomputed from all annotated
seven-donor Xenium fibroblasts, then summarized only across cells carrying a
paired FibMET label. The white-to-red scale shows the unscaled group mean.

```{r fibmet_scmetabolism}
show_panel("fibmet_scmetabolism_dotplot_seven_donors")
```

## Single-cell IMC-Xenium correlation

Each point is one cell with a validated shared identifier. The weak correlations
show that the IMC protein marker averages and transcript-based pathway AUCell
scores measure related but non-equivalent biological layers.

```{r fibmet_correlation}
show_panel("fibmet_imc_scmetabolism_correlation_seven_donors")
```

```{r fibmet_correlation_table}
kable(
  fib_cor_stats,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Fibroblast matched-cell Spearman correlations"
)
```

## Single-cell IMC-Xenium correlation

The paired EC correlations are close to zero in both EndMET states. The panel is

```{r endmet_correlation}
show_panel("endmet_imc_scmetabolism_correlation_seven_donors")
```

```{r endmet_correlation_table}

  ec_cor_stats,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Endothelial matched-cell Spearman correlations"
```

# Annotation sensitivity {.tabset .tabset-pill}

## Concordance

The broad ExcludedValidation population agreement exceeds the prespecified 0.85 threshold.
The fine-subtype results do not support replacing the finalized annotation
space with a Harmony-based refit.

```{r annotation_concordance}
kable(strategy_metrics, digits = 3)
kable(strategy_decision)
```

## Major-marker QC

```{r major_marker_qc}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(qc_plot_dir, "ssc230_major_marker_qc.png"))
```

## Fibroblast-marker QC

Reference mapping represents all eight fibroblast labels and has a higher
cell-weighted canonical-marker specificity than the joint Harmony candidate.

```{r fibroblast_marker_qc}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(qc_plot_dir, "ssc230_fibroblast_marker_qc.png"))
```

## Endothelial-marker QC

The mapped EC labels retain five reference subtypes in ExcludedValidation. Joint Harmony
has slightly higher weighted marker specificity but collapses the query to
three labels, making it unsuitable as a replacement for the curated subtype
space.

```{r endothelial_marker_qc}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(qc_plot_dir, "ssc230_endothelial_marker_qc.png"))
```

## Specificity summary

```{r marker_specificity_table}
kable(marker_specificity, digits = 3)
```

# Scope and methods

The ExcludedValidation portable SFE was restricted to `qc_pass == TRUE` before joining.
The final object contains the identical 5,099-gene row universe for all seven
donors. Counts, logcounts, centroid geometries, and cell-segmentation geometries
were retained; logcounts and size factors were recalculated jointly.

The independent mapping arm used two-stage Seurat RNA anchor transfer from the
finalized six-donor reference: first the nine major populations, then the
fibroblast or endothelial subtype within the mapped parent population. The
joint sensitivity arm used seven-donor LogNormalize/PCA/Harmony integration,
Leiden clustering over a resolution grid, and cluster labels anchored to the
finalized six-donor annotations.

scMetabolism was run with AUCell and the KEGG pathway collection on all final
Xenium fibroblasts and ECs. ECM scores were calculated with AUCell from the
Naba core-matrisome network. IMC glycolysis and TCA/OXPHOS scores are means of
the prespecified z-scored protein marker sets.

```{r cohort_tables}
kable(join_audit, caption = "Joined seven-donor Xenium SFE")
kable(panel_audit, caption = "Cell denominators used in regenerated panels")
```

# Limitations and robustness

<div class="method-note">
The original six-donor fine annotations were produced after ResolVI integration
and manual marker review. The trained ResolVI model/H5AD was not present in the
available project files, so an exact all-seven ResolVI refit could not be
reproduced. Harmony was therefore used only as a transparent sensitivity arm,
not presented as the original integration method.
</div>

The targeted Xenium panel does not pass scMetabolism's coverage threshold for a
separate KEGG oxidative-phosphorylation gene set. The transcriptomic
`TCA / OXPHOS` display row is therefore the citrate-cycle score used in the
previous analysis; no missing OXPHOS value was imputed. The IMC protein score
does include the prespecified TCA/OXPHOS protein markers.

Cell-level distribution tests and correlations can be affected by donor
composition and within-donor dependence. Donor-level plots are shown where
the scientific comparison is inferential; the matched-cell correlations are
descriptive cross-modal checks.

# Recommended manuscript use

Use the reference-mapped seven-donor panels as the primary replacements because
they add ExcludedValidation without redefining the six published donors. Describe the
all-seven Harmony analysis as a sensitivity check confirming robust broad
population placement but lower fine-subtype stability.

For the methods, state that ExcludedValidation passed the same Xenium QC and scoring
pipeline, was mapped to the finalized annotation reference, and entered paired
analyses only through validated shared IMC-Xenium identifiers. Keep the exact
ResolVI-model limitation explicit if the joint sensitivity analysis is
mentioned.

# Further questions

An exact all-seven re-fit could be performed only if the original trained
ResolVI model or its input H5AD and Python environment becomes available. That
would test whether the lower fine-subtype retention is specific to Harmony or
reflects genuine instability after adding ExcludedValidation.
